Ascension is a series of optional modifiers that make the game more challenging. It is initially unlocked by defeating any [[Act 3]] [[Boss]] on a given character, after which Ascension may be toggled when starting a run on that character. Beating an Act 3 Boss on a given Ascension level will then unlock the next Ascension level. Defeating the {{M|Corrupt Heart}} or even entering [[Acts#Act 4: The Ending|Act 4]] is ''not'' required for unlocking Ascension levels.

Ascension modifiers are cumulative: each Ascension level includes all modifiers from previous Ascensions. The maximum Ascension level is {{Asc|20}}.

Each character's respective Ascension level progresses ''independent'' of the others' (e.g. a player can unlock every Ascension level on [[Ironclad]] before unlocking a single Ascension level on [[Silent]]). Any Ascension level that has been unlocked can be selected - for example, even if you have unlocked {{Asc|20}} on [[Defect]], you can still play runs on {{Asc|19}} and below.
